# M2 seed fixtures

plate.step is an agent-created build123d Box(40,30,2), exported through OCCT. Synthetic reference geometry; no third-party data was ingested. Expected dimensions: 40 × 30 × 2 mm; volume: 2400 mm³; area: 2680 mm²; six faces and twelve edges. Numerical tolerance: 1e-5 in the relevant units.

The test module generates additional synthetic STEP fixtures in temporary directories. These are a seed suite, not the industrial regression library needed to close M2.
